shared_elements: long-necked or bird-like creature in profile
repeated geometric patterning within a band
schematic outlined bodies with simple internal line details
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces combine schematic profile animals with horizontal register bands and repeated geometric infill, including chevron/crosshatched-looking patterning. The biggest difference is that A is organized as a fairly symmetrical, central scene above a decorated frieze with framed signs, while B is a stacked animal register with multiple separate creatures and no comparable central flanked composition.
